dedupe_keys.name: lisflood fp 8 1 gpu solver simulation results

description: This archive contains simulation results accompanying the LISFLOOD-FP 8.1 study of GPU-accelerated flood solvers. The University of Sheffield and University of Bristol team supplies separate ZIP packages for Lower Triangle, Upper Lee, Eden, Glasgow and Cockermouth examples. These represent catchment and urban flood simulations, not a continuous monitoring dataset. The archive is free under CC-BY-4.0 and provides a stable DOI for comparing results with the described solver release. It can support replication checks and evaluation of flood-inundation calculations used in infrastructure hazard studies. A limitation is that the registry does not describe internal file formats, grid resolution or each simulated period, so those fields remain unverified here. The paper also notes restrictions on some underlying input data; public simulation results do not establish that every case can be rerun using only this archive. Existing model-lisflood-fp is the related hydrodynamic code. No ZIP files or model outputs were downloaded.
